podcast.body: Soundgarden was one of the new bands that appeared on the "Deep Six" compilation, released in the fall of 1985. This compilation was significant for showcasing the regional sound of the Pacific Northwest. "Other groups to appear on the Deep Six compilation included a new band called Soundgarden."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: Soundgarden was featured on the Deep Six compilation, released by CZ Records. This compilation is considered the first proto-grunge compilation, showcasing bands that played a slower, sludgier, deeper style of punk rock. "And one of the groups featured on Deep Six was Matt's other band Soundgarden, which featured, of course, Chris Cornell."
